question: What is the traditional name of the diagram described in all tantras?
premises: The description is situated in all tantras.
The described structure is explicitly declared.
The name sarvatobhadra is attached to the diagram.
inference: This diagram is declared in all tantras as the sarvatobhadra maṇḍala.
plain_english: In all the tantras, this is declared to be the Sarvatobhadra maṇḍala.
